provenance.creator: Project owner
provenance.build: Early development build; exact build identity not recorded
provenance.purpose: Window-management demonstration; not load testing or release qualification
provenance.source_handling: Original recording and review contact sheets kept local, outside the repository; only sanitized media included

video.metadata_review: Only standard container and codec tags; no identifying source metadata observed

poster.metadata_review: No EXIF or application metadata; only the FFmpeg codec comment

privacy_edit.method: Frame-indexed masks over a heavily downsampled and blurred copy of the source picture
covered_content: Screen Studio live preview containing the recording
privacy_edit.notes: Full-frame masks cover sensitive zooms and transitions

visual_review.scope: All final-output frames in contact sheets; full-resolution checks of terminal zooms, moving masks, the recording preview, and the poster
visual_review.result: No readable WhatsApp names or messages, or private terminal content, observed in the reviewed final output

reproduction.note: The script requires the exact private source hash. Encoder versions can change output bytes; newly rendered media requires review.
